les: Nie elke handel is regverdig nie

items.bewering: Twee maats ruil 'n appel vir 'n pakkie druiwe. Albei stem uit hul eie keuse in en albei weet wat hulle kry. Regverdige handel tussen 'n boer en 'n groot koper vra dieselfde van albei kante.
items.bron: Mapping checked against the FINE/WFTO definition of fair trade as a trading partnership 'based on dialogue, transparency and respect' (wfto-europe.org/definition; wfto-asia.com) and the EU Green Paper analysis that unfair trading practices arise from 'unequal negotiating power and unequal levels of information' (cep.eu policy brief on COM(2013) 37). The swap carries over only the two conditions it claims (consent and knowing what you get), both of which are in those definitions. The lesson does not suggest the friends' equal footing carries over: the next two blocks say outright that farmer and buyer are unequal. A learner reasoning further is not led astray.

items.bewering: Die prys moet ook dek wat die goed die maker werklik gekos het.
items.bron: Fairtrade Australia & New Zealand consumer FAQ (fairtradeanz.org/consumer-faq): the Fairtrade Minimum Price is 'set to cover the cost of sustainable production for that product in that region'; Fairtrade International coffee press release (fairtrade.net, 2026): the floor is 'based on the sustainable cost of production'.

items.bewering: Dit moet die maker genoeg gee om behoorlik te lewe.
items.bron: WFTO 10 Principles, 'Fair Payment' (wfto.com/our-fair-trade-system/our-10-principles-of-fair-trade): payment must 'provide fair pay to producers'; 'The aim is always the payment of a Local Living Wage.' The claim is stated as an aim ('moet'), not a guarantee, which matches that wording. It also fits the 'Wat die merk nie belowe nie' block.

items.bewering: Onregverdige handel lyk van buite na dieselfde soort ruil. Die een kant het baie minder keuse of baie minder inligting as die ander.
items.bron: cep.eu policy brief on the European Commission Green Paper on unfair B2B trading practices (COM(2013) 37): unfair trading practices 'result from unequal negotiating power and unequal levels of information on the part of the contracting parties'; UIA Encyclopedia of World Problems, 'inequitable bargaining' (encyclopedia.uia.org).

items.bewering: Daardie kant kry ook minder terug as wat sy werk werd is.
items.bron: UIA Encyclopedia, inequitable bargaining: outcomes 'disproportionately favor the stronger party'; Mitra, Mookherjee, Torero & Visaria, West Bengal potato farmers (people.bu.edu/dilipm working paper; IFPRI South Asia summary): large gap between wholesale and farmgate prices for poorly informed farmers.

items.bewering: Die mense wat die goed maak is dikwels baie en elkeen van hulle is klein. Die kopers is gewoonlik min en elkeen van hulle is groot.
items.blok: Hoekom die een kant minder kry
items.bron: ICCO document T7.215 (icco.org): about 5.5 million small farmers supply world cocoa, while 'only eight transnational companies control 60-80% of the trading and grinding process'; UNCTAD TDB63 presentation (unctad.org): smallholders produce 80-90% of world cocoa, and downstream mergers have raised market concentration. The quantifiers 'dikwels' and 'gewoonlik' are hedged rather than absolute, which suits this evidence.

items.bewering: Baie oeste hou net 'n paar dae
items.blok: Hoekom die een kant minder kry
items.bron: ICAR-Indian Institute of Horticultural Research (iihr.res.in, post-harvest technology): firm red-ripe tomatoes 'will stay for 5 to 6 days at room temperature'; UC ANR extension material (ccfruitandnuts.ucanr.edu): strawberries last 5-7+ days even when cooled at once, and warm exposure halves the marketable fruit after 7 hours. The claim says 'baie' (many), not all, which holds.

items.bewering: 'n klein boer het selde 'n koel stoorplek.
items.blok: Hoekom die een kant minder kry
items.bron: ISHS Acta Horticulturae 1225_9 (ishs.org): 'conventional cold rooms are unaffordable for most smallholder farmers' in Africa; ACIAR report on smallholder market access in Pakistan, citing FAO 2017, on the lack of cold storage infrastructure.

items.bewering: Dikwels kom min kopers by die plaas verby.
items.blok: Hoekom die een kant minder kry
items.bron: ACIAR, 'Smallholder access to markets in Pakistan' (research.aciar.gov.au): markets are dominated by intermediaries, with 'an unequal power balance between buyers and sellers'; CDD Mozambique paper on cooperatives and bargaining power (cddmoz.org): farmers report that the buyers who come to collect the product set the price.

items.bewering: Die boer weet meestal nie wat sy goed in 'n verre winkel kos nie.
items.blok: Hoekom die een kant minder kry
items.bron: Mitra, Mookherjee, Torero & Visaria (Boston University working paper / CEPR DP11548): farmers 'were poorly informed about wholesale and retail prices'; Arinloye et al., pineapple farmers in Benin and Ghana (biblio1.iita.org): farmers face market information asymmetry, which leads to lower prices. Both are case studies, but they are peer-level research and agree with each other. 'Meestal' refers to the small farmer described in the block, not to every farmer.

items.bewering: Al daardie dinge maak dit swaar om 'n lae aanbod te weier. Vir die koper is dieselfde lae prys 'n goeie koop.
items.blok: Hoekom die een kant minder kry
items.bron: Peer-reviewed study cited via agrifoodscience.com (TURJAF): 'the perishable nature of the product ... further limits farmers' bargaining power'; tutor2u economics reference on monopsony power of global food buyers over small-scale farmers. Both describe the same mechanism: a weak seller accepts a low offer and the stronger buyer gains.

items.bewering: Regverdig beteken nie dat albei kante ewe veel kry nie. Dit beteken dat niemand gedwing of mislei is nie en dat die werk genoeg betaal word.
items.bron: FINE/WFTO definition (wfto-europe.org/definition): fair trade 'seeks greater equity', meaning fairness, not equal shares, through 'dialogue, transparency and respect' and better trading conditions; WFTO 'Fair Payment' principle (wfto.com): price 'mutually negotiated and agreed by all' and fair pay. No definition found requires equal division between the parties.

items.bewering: Onregverdige handel is 'n egte deel van handel. Baie boere wat kakao kweek, verdien nie genoeg om behoorlik te lewe nie.
items.bron: van Vliet et al. 2021, Frontiers in Sustainable Food Systems (doi 10.3389/fsufs.2021.732831), six household datasets from Cote d'Ivoire and Ghana: 'the majority (73-90%) do not earn a Living Income'; KIT/Sudwind 2017 paper on the ICCO site (T7.196): most West African cocoa farmers live below the World Bank poverty line. 'Baie' is weaker than the evidence and is safe even if farmgate prices rose after the 2024 price spike.

items.bewering: Tog is nie alle handel onregverdig nie.
items.bron: Follows from the same definitions (cep.eu, WFTO): unfairness depends on a gap in power or information, which is absent from many trades. Fairtrade International's existence and audited trade (flocert.net) show that trade on audited fair terms takes place.

items.bewering: Op party produkte staan 'n keurmerk vir regverdige handel. Dit wys dat iemand die handel agter die produk nagegaan het.
items.bron: FLOCERT history and FAQ (flocert.net/flocert-history-with-fairtrade; text.flocert.net/faqs): FLOCERT 'carries out independent inspections of producers and traders ... to verify that they're complying with the Fairtrade Standards', and audits traders as well as producers, so the trade behind the product is checked; Fairtrade International certification page (fairtrade.net/about/certification).

items.bewering: Die reëls van so 'n merk kom van een organisasie.
items.bron: FLOCERT FAQ (text.flocert.net/faqs): Fairtrade International 'sets the Fairtrade Standards ... and owns the Fairtrade Mark'; Fairtrade ANZ FAQ: Standards are set by 'the Standards Unit at Fairtrade International'. Producers are consulted and co-own the system, but the standard-setting body is one organisation.

items.bewering: Aparte keurders besoek die plase en gee die merk as die reëls nagekom word.
items.bron: FLOCERT history page (flocert.net): set up as a subsidiary of Fairtrade International 'to act independently of the standard-setting side', so it is a separate body, though Fairtrade International remains its sole shareholder. FLOCERT holds ISO 17065 accreditation, and its locally based inspectors visit producer organisations (FLOCERT FAQ; US DOL ILAB statement on annual and unannounced audits). A note on compression: strictly, the inspectors grant CERTIFICATION, and Fairtrade organisations license use of the Mark to certified companies (Fairtrade ANZ FAQ: 'certify and license the use of the Fairtrade Mark'). Certification is the gate to the Mark, so 'gee die merk' is a fair Grade 6 compression and teaches nothing a learner would go wrong with. Recorded so it is not 'tidied' into a claim that the inspectors own the Mark.

items.bewering: Vir die meeste produkte: 'n laagste prys wat die koper moet betaal, ook wanneer pryse val.
items.blok: Wat die merk vir regverdige handel vra
items.bron: Fairtrade ANZ consumer FAQ (fairtradeanz.org/consumer-faq): 'For most Fairtrade goods there is a Fairtrade Minimum Price'; FLOCERT glossary (flocert.net/glossary/fairtrade-minimum-price): the minimum price applies 'where it exists' and is 'the minimum price that must be paid by buyers to producers', a safety net when the market price is below it. Exceptions confirm the qualifier is needed and correct: flowers and plants (fairtrade.org.uk flowers FAQ) and herbs and spices (fairtrade.net minimum price and premium information page) have no fixed minimum price. The superlative 'laagste' is accurate: it is a floor by definition.

items.bewering: Vir die meeste produkte
items.blok: Wat die merk vir regverdige handel vra
items.bron: Fairtrade ANZ consumer FAQ: 'For most Fairtrade goods there is a Fairtrade Minimum Price'. The exceptions found (flowers and plants; herbs and spices) are a minority of Fairtrade product categories (fairtrade.net minimum price table page; fairtrade.org.uk Fairtrade Flowers Facts & FAQs).

items.bewering: Ekstra geld bo en bo die prys vir die groep boere.
items.blok: Wat die merk vir regverdige handel vra
items.bron: Fairtrade ANZ FAQ: the Premium is 'an additional sum of money which goes into a communal fund' that members decide on democratically; Fairtrade America, 'Democracy in Action: Investing the Fairtrade Premium' (fairtradeamerica.org): paid on top of the selling price, and members of small-scale producer organisations vote on its use. On plantations it goes to a workers' committee instead, but this lesson's frame is groups of farmers, so the claim holds as written.

items.bewering: Geen gedwonge werk en geen kinderarbeid nie.
items.blok: Wat die merk vir regverdige handel vra
items.bron: Fairtrade Standard for Small-scale Producer Organizations (fairtradeamerica.org/app/uploads/2020/08/SPO_EN.pdf) and Fairtrade standards overview (fairtrade.ca): forced labour and child labour are prohibited, following ILO conventions; FLOCERT glossary 'child labour' (flocert.net/glossary/child-labour).

items.bewering: Reëls wat die grond en die water om die plaas beskerm.
items.blok: Wat die merk vir regverdige handel vra
items.bron: Fairtrade standards overview (fairtrade.ca, 'The Fairtrade Standards'): environmental requirements include 'maintenance of soil fertility and water resources', responsible water management and minimal agrochemical use; Fairtrade ANZ FAQ: 'Fairtrade Standards require sustainable farming techniques.'

items.bewering: Die organisasie agter die merk sê self dat dit nie 'n behoorlike inkomste waarborg nie.
items.blok: Wat die merk nie belowe nie
items.bron: Fairtrade International, 'Fairtrade strives for a living income' (fairtrade.net/en/why-fairtrade/why-we-do-it/decent-livelihoods/living-income.html): 'Just being Fairtrade certified doesn't guarantee that farmers will earn a living income'. The same wording appears on several regional Fairtrade pages (NAPP, US, CA). The attribution 'sê self' is accurate.

items.bewering: 'n Groep boere verkoop net soveel onder die merk as wat kopers so bestel.
items.blok: Wat die merk nie belowe nie
items.bron: Fairtrade International, 'Fairtrade production overview' (fairtrade.net/impact/fairtrade-production-overview): 'Fairtrade producers may not be able to sell all of their products on Fairtrade terms' and can sell the rest through conventional channels; Bissinger & Leufkens 2020 (ideas.repec.org, ragrxx v59 i2): the certified market is small, so producers cannot sell the full quantity in it.

items.bewering: By party oeste is dit net 'n klein deel van die oes.
items.blok: Wat die merk nie belowe nie
items.bron: Fairtrade International Impact Platform data for 2023, via fairtradecampaigns.org: only 4% of Fairtrade-certified tea and 36% of certified cocoa were sold on Fairtrade terms; the Fairtrade Foundation (fairtrade.net/uk-en, Brew it Fair media release) says growers sell only around 4% of their certified tea on Fairtrade terms. 'By party oeste' plus 'klein deel' is correctly scoped: tea at 4% fits it squarely.

items.bewering: Die res gaan teen gewone pryse weg.
items.blok: Wat die merk nie belowe nie
items.bron: Fairtrade production overview (fairtrade.net): the unsold share goes through conventional channels; MDPI World 2021 review (world-02-00028): the remainder 'is then sold at the lower market price'.

items.bewering: Handel waar albei kante self instem, weet wat hulle kry, en die maker behoorlik betaal word.
items.bron: FINE/WFTO definition (wfto-europe.org/definition): a partnership based on 'dialogue, transparency and respect' offering better trading conditions to producers; WFTO 'Fair Payment' principle (wfto.com): mutually agreed price that provides fair pay. The three elements (consent, knowing what you get, fair pay) map to agreement, transparency and fair payment. It is simple but not false.

items.bewering: Handel waar die een kant min keuse of inligting het en te min kry.
items.bron: cep.eu policy brief on the EU Green Paper on unfair trading practices: these result 'from unequal negotiating power and unequal levels of information'; the stronger party imposes conditions on the weaker. It is consistent with the study block it summarises.

items.bewering: 'n Merk op 'n produk wat wys iemand het dit nagegaan.
items.bron: Wiktionary 'keurmerk' (Dutch cognate): 'seal of approval'; Dictionary of South African English 'SABS' entry (dsae.co.za/entry/sabs/e06165): the SABS mark is a mark on goods that meet the Bureau's tested standards, the standard South African example of a keurmerk; rijksoverheid.nl on keurmerken (a mark that a product has been checked against requirements). The WAT online entry is behind a login, so the Afrikaans dictionary wording itself was not read; the sense is the same across both cognate languages.

items.bewering: 'n Groep mense wat saam aan een doel werk.
items.bron: Vocabulary.com 'organization': 'a group of people who work together, like a neighborhood association, a charity, a union, or a corporation'; Cambridge Dictionary sense, as quoted on secondary pages: 'a group of people who work together in an organized way for a shared purpose'.

items.bewering: Werk wat iemand moet doen sonder dat hy kan weier.
items.bron: ILO Forced Labour Convention No. 29 (1930), as broken down by the European Labour Authority (ela.europa.eu): work 'exacted from any person under the menace of any penalty and for which the said person has not offered himself voluntarily'; 'offered voluntarily' means free consent and 'freedom to leave at any time'. 'Sonder dat hy kan weier' captures the missing free consent. It is simple and does not cross into falsehood.

items.bewering: Werk deur kinders wat hulle skade doen, wat hulle uit die skool hou, of waarvoor hulle nog te jonk is.
items.bron: ILO child labour topic page (ilo.org/topics-and-sectors/child-labour): child labour is work that is 'hazardous to a child's health and development', 'demands too many hours' or is 'performed by children who are too young'; 'Usually, child labour interferes with a child's right to education'; 'Not all work performed by children is child labour.' The definition's three limbs map to these, and by defining child labour as harmful work it correctly avoids calling all children's work child labour.

opsomming: All 31 checkable claims were confirmed against Fairtrade International, FLOCERT, WFTO, ILO and peer-reviewed sources, including both superlatives ('laagste prys', 'die meeste produkte') and the swap comparison, whose mapping holds; the one thing a person should know is that 'keurders ... gee die merk' compresses certification (by FLOCERT) and Mark licensing (by Fairtrade organisations) into one step, which is acceptable at Grade 6 and should not be 'tidied' into a claim that the inspectors own the Mark.
